name: Hanna Mäkinen
bio:
Hanna Mäkinen's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. Initially a project manager in the manufacturing sector, she found herself drawn to the intricate logistics of rally racing during a corporate sponsorship deal. The demanding schedules and high-pressure environment resonated with her problem-solving skills, leading her to transition into motorsport full-time. Over the years, she's honed her ability to anticipate potential roadblocks, ensuring smooth operations regardless of the challenges.

At 23XI Racing, Hanna is known for her methodical approach. She meticulously plans every detail, from transportation schedules to equipment management. Her colleagues appreciate her calm demeanor under pressure and her dedication to finding creative solutions. While she may not have the flashiest job, Hanna's organizational prowess is the backbone that keeps the team moving forward. Her dedication to finding sustainable logistics solutions sets her apart, reflecting her commitment to the future of motorsports.

Hanna believes that communication is key. She has built strong relationships with vendors and team members alike, fostering a collaborative atmosphere that ensures everyone is on the same page. Her ambition extends beyond personal success; she envisions a future where motorsport events are models of efficiency and sustainability.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave and side part.
physical.description: Hanna is a woman of medium height with a warm, approachable face framed by her blonde hair.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical charts and reminders.
Has a peculiar fondness for licorice, which she chews during stressful moments.
Insists on double-checking every manifest personally, even if it means staying late.
